name: jm
description: Josh Meads's agent plugins for Claude Code and Codex: jm:stack (Open Pstack with Josh's model routing), jm:games, and jm:tools.

plugins.name: jm-stack
plugins.description: jm:stack: Lauren Tan's pstack for Claude Code and Codex with Josh Meads's model routing. Based on Open Pstack (ericlitman/open-pstack), which began from michael-denyer/pstack-claude and ports cursor/plugins/pstack.

plugins.name: jm-games
plugins.description: Game and graphics skills: GDD and staged browser-game delivery (mini-GDD, MVP, final), three.js, react-three-fiber, Phaser, audio, Blender and web QA tools, version-specific three.js facts, and a reference-driven art iteration loop.

plugins.name: jm-tools
plugins.description: Working tools: continuation handoffs for a fresh session, adversarial try-to-break checks, before/after visual evidence for UI changes, static hosting, feedback logging, and Codex session export.
